text_markup: The {term:controller of an ability} is the player responsible for that ability. By default, this is the player who controls the ability's source. See also {ref:rule_source}. A player can only use abilities they control.
text_plain: The controller of an ability is the player responsible for that ability. By default, this is the player who controls the ability's source. See also section 9.1.3. A player can only use abilities they control.
